description: Print routing and controlled egress: the only thing on the network allowed to talk to a printer.
_doc: Runs ghcr.io/kisaesdevlab/vibe-printer - the SAME image the Vibe Appliance installs, so a firm running both runs one packaging of one product. It is an API print gateway, not a print server: it dials OUT to devices on tcp/9100 and tcp/631 and publishes no IPP queues. The scanner inbox does not exist upstream yet, so SENT-PR-009 is not enforced by this module. Held/PIN release was WITHDRAWN (build plan v1.7, §11 R26) - every job prints on submission and nothing claims otherwise. NOT CUSTOMER-FACING: userFacing is false because the ONLY manifest-level gate on the public landing page and on the Settings > Customer landing tab is `userFacing !== false`. Without it an operator could toggle Wazuh, CrowdSec or Vaultwarden onto a firm's client-facing page - and the URL the console would print for it 404s anyway, since this appliance renders no route for a foreign runtime. These are staff and infrastructure surfaces reached through Sentinel's own ingress.

preUninstallExport.description: pg_dump of every database, a tarball per volume, host state, config and an EXPORT-MANIFEST.json. Runs BEFORE anything is removed; skipping takes a typed confirmation.

health.doc: Run from the module's directory in the installer checkout; exit 0 means healthy. Several modules have no HTTP surface to probe, and pulse's probe must assert the pinned build is the one running rather than merely that something answered.
